claims.claim_text: The reporting period ended 31 December 2024.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: intro paragraph

claims.claim_text: The reporting boundary for the metrics in this section is based on financial control.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: intro paragraph

claims.claim_text: Metrics are prepared for reporting year 2024 and, where available, include comparative information for 2022 and 2023.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Reporting period, boundary and connectivity
claims.support_notes: Comparatives are stated as included only "where available"; IFRS S1 requires comparative information for preceding period for all amounts disclosed.

claims.claim_text: The Bank uses metrics to monitor operational emissions (Scopes 1–3 where measured), financed emissions (Scope 3 Category 15), and exposure to higher-carbon sectors.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Reporting period, boundary and connectivity
claims.support_notes: Describes metrics used to monitor sustainability-related risks/opportunities.

claims.claim_text: These measures are used in decision-making through the application of internal carbon prices to lending and investment decisions.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Reporting period, boundary and connectivity
claims.support_notes: Connects metrics to decision-making and performance monitoring.

claims.claim_text: For 2024, Scope 1 emissions were 2,634.908317 tCO2e and include fleet emissions.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Operational GHG emissions metrics > Scope 1
claims.support_notes: Quantitative metric and scope definition provided.

claims.claim_text: A correction was made to the pre-computed Scope 1 figure for 2024 due to errors including non-zero values for electric vehicles; the corrected value is used for performance monitoring.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Operational GHG emissions metrics > Scope 1
claims.support_notes: Explains reason for correction and which figure is used, but does not disclose the original pre-computed value, the difference, or revised comparative amounts (if applicable).

claims.claim_text: Scope 2 emissions are disclosed using both location-based and market-based approaches; 2024 location-based Scope 2 was 6,963.4977 tCO2e and 2024 market-based Scope 2 was 3,060.5382 tCO2e.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Operational GHG emissions metrics > Scope 2
claims.support_notes: Both approaches and values are explicitly disclosed.

claims.claim_text: Market-based Scope 2 emissions are sourced directly from utility invoice data and reflect market-based accounting with grid emission factors adjusted for renewable energy certificates and power purchase agreements; registry information is used for narrative only and not subtracted again to avoid double-counting.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Operational GHG emissions metrics > Scope 2 narrative
claims.support_notes: Describes inputs, adjustments and a key assumption (no double-counting).

claims.claim_text: For 2024, Scope 3 business travel emissions were 289.8833 tCO2e.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Operational GHG emissions metrics > Scope 3 (business travel)
claims.support_notes: Quantitative metric disclosed.

claims.claim_text: For corporate loans, financed emissions are disclosed for 2022–2024 and total loans are 31,150.64 EUR million for the years presented.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Financed emissions > Corporate loans financed emissions
claims.support_notes: Industry-relevant banking metric disclosed; comparatives include 2022 and 2023 but not explicitly stated as preceding-period-only and total loans constant across years may require explanation.

evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Financed emissions > Corporate loans financed emissions
claims.support_notes: Absolute financed emissions disclosed with multi-year values.

claims.claim_text: Financed emissions for corporate loans are calculated as outstanding_amount_meur / evic_meur × total_ghg_tco2e, citing PCAF Standard §B62.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Methodology (corporate loans)
claims.support_notes: External source (PCAF) identified and calculation method stated.

claims.claim_text: For listed equity holdings where direct issuer emissions are not available, the Bank applies a PCAF proxy approach using issuer revenue (EUR million) as the proxy basis.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Listed equity financed emissions (proxy-based approach)
claims.support_notes: Defines proxy metric and rationale for substitution.

claims.claim_text: Listed equity financed emissions are calculated as market_value_meur / issuer_evic_meur × issuer_revenue_meur, citing PCAF Standard §B61 proxy with revenue substituted for direct issuer emissions due to absence of counterparty-level emissions data.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Methodology (listed equity)
claims.support_notes: Source and deviation/substitution are explicitly described.

claims.claim_text: For listed equity positions disclosed for 2024, market values (EUR million) were 23.93, 556.4, 35.36, 79.11, 25.57, 1,886.33, 2,564.65, and 288.08; nominal amounts (EUR million) where available were 27.98 and 636.77; currency is EUR; proxy basis is issuer_revenue_meur.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Listed equity positions disclosed for 2024
claims.support_notes: Discloses key inputs used in calculation.

claims.claim_text: Where the listed equity proxy approach is applied, the stated reason is that direct issuer emissions are unavailable; revenue is used as PCAF B61 proxy and should not be treated as verified emissions.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Listed equity proxy reason statement
claims.support_notes: Provides limitation/qualification of proxy-based results.

claims.claim_text: For certain sovereign positions, the Bank uses national Scope 1 emissions as a reference metric; national Scope 1 values included are 675,000,000.0, 290,000,000.0, 330,000,000.0, and 150,000,000.0 tCO2e.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Sovereign exposure (national Scope 1 reference metric)
claims.support_notes: Values disclosed but countries/issuers are not identified, limiting interpretability and traceability.

evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Sovereign exposure purchase dates
claims.support_notes: Dates disclosed but without linking to specific sovereign positions.

claims.claim_text: The Bank uses a financed-emissions intensity metric expressed as tCO2e per EUR million, with a target intensity metric of 20.0 tCO2e per EUR million.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Financed-emissions intensity metric
claims.support_notes: Metric type (intensity) and target value disclosed.

claims.claim_text: High-carbon sector exposure is 11,059.49 EUR million and represents 35.5% of total loans.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Exposure to higher-carbon sectors
claims.support_notes: Absolute and relative exposure metrics disclosed.

claims.claim_text: The Bank applies internal carbon prices in decision-making: EUR 42.73 per tCO2e (investment decisions; applies to financed emissions and lending decisions), EUR 48.73 per tCO2e (product pricing; does not apply to financed emissions or lending decisions), and EUR 54.73 per tCO2e (investment decisions; does not apply to financed emissions; applies to lending decisions).
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Internal carbon pricing
claims.support_notes: Discloses internal price levels and application scope.

claims.claim_text: The Bank has established climate-related targets covering operational emissions (Scopes 1 and 2), financed emissions (Scope 3 Category 15), and an all-scopes target; progress is monitored using the metrics described.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Climate-related targets overview
claims.support_notes: States existence of targets and linkage to metrics.

claims.claim_text: Target TGT001 covers Scope 1 and Scope 2 (whole entity), is an absolute reduction target for all Kyoto 7 gases, baseline year 2020 with baseline value 137,849.0 tCO2e, target value 42% reduction, interim milestones of 120,480.0 tCO2e (2025) and 97,321.4 tCO2e (2028), status on track, progress in 2024 of 40.0%, and third-party validation by SBTi.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Target TGT001 — Scope 1 and Scope 2 absolute reduction
claims.support_notes: Most required target attributes are disclosed; the period over which the target applies (end year) is not explicitly stated beyond interim milestones.

claims.claim_text: The financed emissions target covers Scope 3 Category 15 (whole entity) using metric tCO2e per EUR million lending; baseline year 2022 with baseline value 20.0; target value 30% reduction; sectoral decarbonisation yes; interim milestones 18.2 (2025) and 15.8 (2028); progress in 2024 is 25.0%; third-party validation by UNEP FI.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Financed emissions target — Scope 3 Category 15 (intensity)
claims.support_notes: Discloses metric, baseline, milestones, progress and validation; target period/end date not explicitly stated.

claims.claim_text: The all-scopes target covers all scopes (whole entity) with baseline value 120,000.0; progress metric is percentage reduction versus baseline; progress in 2024 is 13.3%; planned use of carbon credits is 8.2% of the target plan; planned credit type is technology removal; third-party validated.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: All-scopes target (including planned use of carbon credits)
claims.support_notes: Baseline unit (e.g., tCO2e) and baseline year/base period are not stated; target period not stated; validation party not named.

claims.claim_text: The Bank discloses a carbon credit volume metric of 21,080 tCO2e of total credits.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Carbon credit volume metric
claims.support_notes: Quantitative metric disclosed.

claims.claim_text: Data-quality mix for the emissions dataset is: audited report 0.7%, CDP disclosure 35.5%, estimated (economic) 47.5%, proxy model 16.3%.
